Talia Morgan: Quick PM follow-up: recurring memory pressure events during model rollouts. Need explicit action owners, an initial ticket for a hotfix, and a RACI. Prefer minimal scope first, then a design ticket if needed.
Noah Kim: I can take the hotfix to cap per-worker memory and add a quick watchdog. Target 5 business days.
Priyanka Desai: I'll own the metrics + postmortem recurring-pattern entry. Will add a "post-rollout mem-peak" metric and a 10m alert.
Evan Brooks: I'll handle the rollout gating and canary automation. Add rollback thresholds tied to OOMs and error-rate.
Talia Morgan: OK. Create INF-9780 for the hotfix and INF-9781 for the longer redesign (memory profiles + warmup). Add label pm-followup.
Noah Kim: Creating INF-9780 now : INF-9780 - rollout mem cap + watchdog (hotfix). Target 5bd.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Noah: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9780 (INF-9780)
Noah Kim: Hotfix plan (short): 1) enforce per-worker memory cap 2) small watchdog that drops low-priority jobs if mem > threshold 3) smoke tests + canary.
Priyanka Desai: INF-9781 created as a design spike: memory profiling, warmup priming, and adaptive placement. Target 3w.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Priyanka: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9781 (INF-9781)
Priyanka Desai: RACI draft: R: Noah (INF-9780) / Priyanka (INF-9781 design), A: Talia (PM signoff), C: Evan (canary/infra) + Eng-oncall, I: Support + CS.
Evan Brooks: I'll wire a canary that will run the hotfix against 2 internal orgs. Rollback if OOMs >1 in 10m or error-rate >0.7% sustained 5m.
Talia Morgan: Checkpoints: 48h status update, demo after 4bd, full rollout after 5bd hotfix. Handoff rule: if owner offline >3bd, hand to rotation lead (Evan). Add to ticket template.
Noah Kim: Pasted quick log sample to INF-9780: ```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] WARN model-swap: mem_usage=91% worker_id=57
[2026-03-18T09:12:04Z] ERROR runtime: OOM triggered, request dropped
```
Priyanka Desai: Adding the new metric and linking both tickets in the recurring-incident tracker. Also adding an acceptance test to ensure no OOMs during a 10m sustained rollout in staging.
Evan Brooks: Scheduling the canary for Friday morning internal window. Will add automated rollback hooks.
Talia Morgan: Final owners: Noah (INF-9780), Priyanka (INF-9781 metrics/design), Evan (canary + rollback). Please assign and tag pm-followup. Post short updates in this thread and link PRs. Ping me @Talia if blocked. :white_check_mark:
